intro.line: An Omenpath opens where no Omenpath should. On the other side, crystals hum under a sky that belongs to another story.
This world is not part of the Multiverse you know. Its heroes have their own war. You are only passing through.
Recorded: crossings sit outside Magic canon. The road waits for you on the far side.

finale.line: Sephiroth falls. The Lifestream, green and slow, closes over the wound in the planet.
It's not over yet... this isn't the end!
The Omenpath folds shut behind you. The crystal sky is gone. The road turns back to the Multiverse.

villainFinale.line: In this version the planet already belongs to him.
This is the end... for all of you.
The Lifestream is quiet. The Omenpath stays open a little longer than it should, then closes.

battles.title: Job Select
battles.blurb: A mercenary in a city of reactors and glowing mako. Shinra security does not like strangers.

scene.line: Midgar. The reactors never sleep.
I'll control the world with fear. It takes too much to do it like my old man.
Job select: when an equipment enters, it makes a 1/1 Hero and attaches itself. A new job for a new body.

villainScene.line: Shinra security: eyes up, weapons ready. Nobody walks through Sector Seven.

hero.half: Play equipment: each one brings its own Hero.

battles.title: Summons
battles.blurb: A knight carries a fire god inside him. The Empire wants it back.

cards.name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden of Inferno

scene.line: Thank you, Torgal. For never giving up.
Hm! Not bad for a human.
Summons are Saga creatures: they arrive, do their work over three turns, then the Saga ends. Time them.

villainScene.line: The Dominant is ours. The Empire collects what it is owed.

hero.half: Summons last three turns. Play them before the big attack.

battles.title: Kefka
battles.blurb: A court mage laughs while the world burns. The Returners will not stand for it.

cards.name: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin
Garland, Knight of Cornelia // Chaos, the Endless

card.name: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin

scene.line: Sabin...let's settle this with the toss of a coin.
I was there... I saw when Kefka used his Light of Judgment to torch the village of Mobliz, far to the east.
He makes you discard. Keep your best cards in play, not in your hand.

villainScene.line: Ha ha! Burn it all, then do it again for the people in the back.

hero.half: He strips your hand. Play your cards out.

battles.title: Izzet Prowess
battles.blurb: A young black mage and a soldier who has forgotten her name. Spells fly both ways.

scene.line: Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys.
Prowess: when you cast a noncreature spell, the creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Cast a spell, then swing.

villainScene.line: I had to be strong for Serah, so I thought I needed to forget my past. And I became Lightning.

hero.half: Cast a spell before you attack to grow the creature.

battles.title: The Long Pilgrimage
battles.blurb: A blitzball star on a pilgrimage with the guardians of a summoner. A giant called Sin waits at the end.

deck.name: Sin's Pilgrimage
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Sin itself is three colours; this deck is black, the colour of its toxins.

scene.line: Spira. The sea is calm, and everyone on the shore is waiting for something.
All I can do is go forward. Keep fighting and surviving, until I find the answers I need.
Counterspells answer a spell as it is cast. Keep mana open and let the big spell resolve in the second turn.

villainScene.line: A shadow on the water. It does not speak. It only returns.

hero.half: Hold mana open and counter their biggest spell.

battles.title: The Road Trip
battles.blurb: Four friends and a car on a long road. The empire wants the prince, and the road is long.

scene.line: A road across a kingdom that is not yours. A black car, a full tank, and a chocobo on the horizon.
As long as there are people who need to be protected, I'll keep on fighting!
Vehicles are artifacts that fight when crewed. Tap creatures with enough power and the car attacks.

villainScene.line: The throne belongs to the empire. The prince is only a name on a road.

hero.half: Crew the Regalia with your creatures to attack.

battles.title: Golgari Summons vs Azorius Control
battles.blurb: Two decks of the set. One calls the summons, one tries to answer every spell it casts.

scene.line: The Shinra people told us that everyone would be happy once the reactor was built. But all it brought us was sadness...
They answer spells. Cast a cheap one first, then the summon you need.

villainScene.line: Every spell has a price. We make you pay it twice.

hero.half: Bait a counter with a cheap spell first.

battles.title: Sephiroth
battles.blurb: The fabled SOLDIER believes the planet already belongs to him. Cloud and his friends say otherwise.

cards.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

card.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

scene.line: You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain?
I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know.
This is the end... for all of you.
His card transforms into One-Winged Angel. Kill him early or race the clock.

villainScene.line: Fate is not to be taken lightly, Cloud.
The planet is mine. It has always been mine.

hero.half: He transforms. Remove him before he grows.

battles.title: Ultimate Weapon
battles.blurb: Past the final fight, the planet keeps one more secret: a weapon too large to name.

archive.what: A green deck of the largest monsters in the set: Diamond Weapon, Ancient Adamantoise and Coliseum Behemoth.
archive.why: It is a big-creature gauntlet in the JRPG tradition, not a deck anyone won with.
archive.beat: Block the first big creature, chump the second, and burn it out before the third lands.
archive.after: Nothing; this is the optional superboss at the end of the story.

deck.name: The Weapons
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's set only. No tournament list is copied.

scene.line: The crystal sky splits. Something that has been asleep since before the war turns over.
It is huge. Kill it before the third monster arrives.

after.line: Recorded: the Ultimate Weapon sleeps again. The crystal sky closes.

hero.half: Chump the first, remove the second.
